metadata.author: Momma Bear Audio
metadata.description:
Boredom Busters takes the pressure off figuring out what to do next with 99 different activities, challenges, games and creative ideas for kids. Each activity is its own audio track, so simply hit shuffle and let the audio choose what comes next!The activities include a huge mix of movement, pretend play, building, art, observation, creativity and even a few helpful chores. Kids might build a blanket fort, complete a secret agent mission, invent a new sport, draw a treasure map, put on a concert, race through a one-minute exercise challenge or create their own restaurant.Some activities take just a minute while others can turn into an afternoon of play. Most require little to no setup and encourage kids to use what they already have around them.Perfect for weekends, summer days, quiet afternoons or anytime you hear those two familiar words: “I’m bored!” Just shuffle, press play and see what comes next.

Looking for other free audio sources, ideas and inspo? Maybe you want to submit a request for some sort of specific audio for your kids? Join my FB Group! I am always taking suggestions and working to get the audio your kids want.
